# LISTA 2

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "me315.sqlite")
```

## 1

```{sql connection=con}

SELECT STATE, PNO, PNAME
FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY STATE ASC
```

## 2

```{sql connection = con}

SELECt STATE, PNO, PNAME
FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY STATE DESC
```

## 3

```{sql, connection = con}
SELECT STATE, PNO, PNAME
FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY STATE, PNO DESC

```

## 4

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT STATE, PNO, PNAME
FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE = "AZ"
ORDER BY PNO DESC

```

## 5

```{sql connection = con}

SELECT STATE, ACRES, PNAME
FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE = "AZ"
ORDER BY PNAME

```

## 6

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT *
FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY 4 DESC, 2 ASC


```

### PARA PENSAR

Nome da coluna. já que fica mais preciso onde queremos ir, inibindo o código de possíveis erros e um "snowball"

## 7

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT PNO, PNAME
FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY ACRES DESC

```

## 8

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT STATE, FEE, PNAME
FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY STATE ASC, FEE DESC, PNAME DESC;


```

## 9

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT PNO, ACRES
FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY PNO ASC
LIMIT 3

```

# HANDS ON

## 1

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT *
FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY ACRES ASC
```

## 2

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT PNAME, FEE
FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE = 'MT'
ORDER BY PNAME DESC

```

## 3

```{sql connection = con}
select fee, acres
from PRESERVE
ORDER BY FEE, ACRES
```

## 4

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT PNAME
FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE = 'AZ'
ORDER BY PNO ASC
```

## 5

```{sql connection = con}

SELECT STATE, FEE, PNO
  FROM PRESERVE
  WHERE ACRES > 100
  ORDER BY STATE DESC, FEE DESC, PNO ASC
```

## 6

```{sql connection = con}
   SELECT *
  FROM PRESERVE
  WHERE STATE >= 'M'

```

## 7

```{sql connection = con}
 SELECT *
  FROM PRESERVE
  WHERE PNAME < 'TATKON'
```

## 9 

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT *
  FROM EMPLOYEE
  ORDER BY ENAME ASC
```

## 10

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT ENAME, SALARY
  FROM EMPLOYEE
  WHERE SALARY > 2000
  ORDER BY SALARY DESC
```
